---
title: "Timothy Smiley, 1930-2026"
date: "2026-10-24"
---

Sad news that the logician and philosopher Timothy Smiley died earlier this week in Cambridge, a few days before his 96th birthday. 

Timothy was still working a little on logic and philosophy a year ago, and friends tell me he kept his wits and an interest in events to the last. 

The end of an era. And I, in particular, must owe my whole career to him.
